description: This file defines a controller class for the Customer Search report in an OpenCart extension. It handles displaying the report, filtering data, saving settings, and generating report output.

classes.name: CustomerSearch
classes.description: Controller class for managing customer search reports, including viewing, filtering, and saving report settings.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Initializes the customer search report page, loading language, settings, and layout components.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the report settings via the setting model, after permission check.

methods.name: report
methods.description: Prepares and displays the customer search report view.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Returns the customer search report list as raw output.

methods.name: getReport
methods.description: Fetches and formats the customer search data based on filters, pagination, and generates the report view.
